propositions: rebar link can silently record a different edge than requested when crossing type tiers, failing to record the requested child-level dependency
blocking edges can be written where a ticket blocks its own descendant or ancestor, distorting ready and next-batch work order computation
resolve_hierarchy_link decides comparability from TYPE_TIER instead of structural position in the parent hierarchy, allowing incomparable tickets to link
the escalation contract for cross-subtree links must remain unchanged: auto-escalate and emit a redirect record for callers that depend on it
legacy edges written under the type-tier rule must be detectable store-wide and repairable in a single pass without breaking the new resolver semantics
ancestor-blocking edges must be unrepresentable by any code path into the resolver after the structural comparability fix
